scientific.integrity: The source equation and threshold theorem were checked against their full published PDF and the mathematical proof is independent. The global critical Lyapunov derivative, the simple zero infected eigenvalue and stable projection, scalar forced-response ratios, coefficient positivity, and variance identity were reconstructed explicitly. A standalone rational-plus-ODE checker tests a concrete admissible critical example. Broader threshold literature was compared at the statement level. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The complete asymptotic profile requires initially nonzero infection and exactly critical deterministic normalized dynamics with positive demographic and transition rates. The fixed-threshold heterogeneity comparison holds only when mean transmissibility and all other parameters are fixed. No stochastic, spatial, or next-order asymptotic theorem is claimed.

title: Critical SLEIRS relaxation reveals a susceptibility-variance law at fixed reproduction number
